item.title: Birmingham City Council Approves Agreement for ACIPCO Expansion, Creates 80 Jobs
item.description: By Barnett Wright | The Birmingham Times The Birmingham City Council on Tuesday approved an agreement with American Cast Iron Pipe Company (ACIPCO) to undertake a major expansion of its manufacturing facilities and corporate headquarters.
